- some current, some years out of date
- none searchable, none reviewed by anyone but the author
- moving into ServiceNow Knowledge Management
caption: Three requirements: audience split, real sign-off, a cadence against future rot.

steps.label: IT Staff KB

steps.label: Triage first

code:
Every migrated article starts: Draft

Trigger: workflow_state Draft -> Review
Action:  Ask for Approval -> Knowledge manager
Approve: -> Published, Published date stamped
Reject:  -> Draft, reviewer comments attached
caption: Polished in Word still means unreviewed inside ServiceNow.

code:
Scheduled job, runs quarterly:
  Published article, last update > 12 months ago
    -> flagged to Knowledge manager
    -> confirm (resets clock) or send back to Draft
  No longer applies -> Retired, not deleted
caption: The migration doesn't end the rot unless something checks for it ongoing.
